article_content: Rev. Al Sharpton, the controversial civil rights leader-turned-broadcaster, was a confidential FBI informant for years and allegedly helped federal authorities jail members of the Genovese and Gambino organized crime families, according to a recent exposé. President Barack Obama is scheduled to speak for a second time at the annual meeting of Sharpton's National Action Network. The Smoking Gun published documents suggesting that Sharpton provided information to an FBI task force composed of agents and NYPD detectives in the 1980s. Investigators reportedly supplied The Smoking Gun with evidence showing that Sharpton recorded conversations with mob figures using a customized briefcase, resulting in wiretaps of Genovese social clubs and phone lines. Sharpton has been in Obama's sphere dating back to the president's time as an Illinois state legislator. Sharpton denies being a full-fledged informant, stating that his FBI assistance was limited to cases of drug dealing in minority communities and possible exploitation of Black artists in the music industry. Vincent 'Chin' Gigante, a Genovese crime family boss, pretended to be mentally ill to block law enforcement. Sharpton's alleged recordings captured mobsters discussing Gigante's ruse, helping undermine his defense. Sharpton also advised Tawana Brawley in 1988 during her infamous case, which was later exposed as a hoax. Critics say Sharpton capitalized on her claims, while supporters credit him for highlighting racial injustice issues at the time. Court documents reveal that Sharpton may have provided information leading to key wiretaps against the Genovese family. These tapes contributed to racketeering convictions, including that of Federico 'Fritzy' Giovanelli. Sharpton's National Action Network, set to host President Obama, reportedly owes $1.9 million in back taxes. Sharpton himself has personal financial liabilities related to a failed 2004 presidential campaign. Sharpton has visited the White House multiple times on various issues, attended the First Lady's 50th birthday party, and was a guest at a State Dinner honoring French President François Hollande. He brought his girlfriend, who was significantly younger than him. Sharpton insists in his book 'The Rejected Stone' that suggestions of him being a government snitch are efforts to silence his activism. He maintains that the FBI once set him up by leaking potentially dangerous misinformation.

Predsednik Barak Obama planira da se po drugi put obrati na godišnjem sastanku Šarptonove organizacije National Action Network. The Smoking Gun je objavio dokumenta u kojima se navodi da je Šarpton dostavljao informacije specijalnoj grupi sastavljenoj od agenata FBI-ja i detektiva njujorške policije (NYPD) tokom osamdesetih godina. Istražioci su navodno prosledili The Smoking Gun-u dokaze da je Šarpton snimao razgovore sa mafijaškim vođama pomoću specijalno modifikovanog kofera, što je dovelo do prisluškivanja đenoveških klubova i telefonskih linija. Šarpton je bio u krugu Obaminih saradnika još od vremena kada je Obama bio državni poslanik u Ilinoisu. Šarpton negira da je bio punopravni doušnik i tvrdi da je njegova pomoć FBI-ju bila ograničena na slučajeve trgovine drogom u manjinskim zajednicama i moguću eksploataciju crnačkih umetnika u muzičkoj industriji. Šarpton je takođe savetovao Tavanu Brolij 1988. godine tokom njenog ozloglašenog slučaja, za koji se kasnije ispostavilo da je prevara. Kritičari tvrde da je Šarpton iskoristio njene tvrdnje, dok ga pristalice hvale jer je ukazao na rasnu nepravdu. National Action Network, organizacija koja će ugostiti predsednika Obamu, navodno duguje 1,9 miliona dolara zaostalog poreza. Šarpton lično ima finansijske obaveze povezane sa neuspelom predsedničkom kampanjom iz 2004. godine. Šarpton je više puta posećivao Belu kuću, prisustvovao 50. rođendanu prve dame i bio gost na državnoj večeri u čast francuskog predsednika Fransoa Olanda. Doveo je tada i svoju devojku, znatno mlađu od njega. U knjizi 'The Rejected Stone', Šarpton insistira da su tvrdnje o njegovoj saradnji sa vladom pokušaj da se uguši njegov aktivizam. Tvrdi da ga je FBI jednom namerno doveo u opasnost puštanjem lažnih informacija.

article_content: 'An outpouring of tributes followed the shocking death of 19-year-old Carl Salomon, who plummeted from a 30-metre crane on a construction barge in Balmain East, Sydney. Police remain unsure whether he fell or jumped, but they suspect he and a friend had been drinking and engaging in risky behavior around 5am. Despite his friend’s attempts to assist him, Carl disappeared, and his body was discovered four hours later. A 2013 Newington College graduate, he was a noted athlete and served as Captain of Fletcher House during his final year. Those who knew him recall his charismatic and fun-loving spirit. His principal, Dr David Mulford, commended Carl’s leadership and extended sympathy to his family. The tragedy has deeply affected the Newington community, with police citing it as an avoidable incident tied to alcohol and unsafe behavior.'

Policija još utvrđuje da li je on pao ili skočio, ali sumnja da su on i prijatelj pili i ponašali se rizično oko pet sati ujutru. Uprkos pokušajima prijatelja da ga spase, Karl je nestao, a njegovo telo pronađeno je četiri sata kasnije. Kao maturant Newington Koledža iz 2013, bio je istaknuti sportista i služio kao kapiten Fletcher Housea u svojoj poslednjoj godini. Njegovi poznanici ga opisuju kao harizmatičnog, punog života i potencijala. Njegov direktor, dr Dejvid Malford, pohvalio je Karlove liderske sposobnosti i uputio saučešće porodici. Zajednica Newington Koledža je duboko potresena ovim događajem, a policija smatra da je reč o izbegnutoj nesreći povezanoj sa konzumacijom alkohola i nesmotrenim ponašanjem.'

article_content: On Friday, a judge in El Paso County sentenced 32-year-old former Army officer Aaron Lucas to 20 years to life for sexually assaulting young girls in Colorado. Initially, Lucas claimed his twin brother Brian was responsible, but he eventually abandoned that defense and pleaded guilty. Brian Lucas also faces charges of sodomy and first-degree child abuse in Alabama, although he denies any connection to Aaron's crimes. Investigators say DNA evidence linked Aaron to an abduction in Colorado Springs and related incidents in Alabama and Texas. As part of a plea agreement, some Colorado charges were dropped, and authorities decided not to pursue certain cases in Texas and Alabama. During sentencing, parents of the victims delivered emotional testimony asking the judge for the maximum penalty. Aaron Lucas, who had been stationed at Fort Carson and earned the Bronze Star, was reportedly abused himself as a child, according to his mother. She added that serving in Afghanistan left him with deep emotional scars. However, prosecutors noted that Lucas repeatedly targeted young girls by offering money or ice cream. The crimes began shortly after Lucas arrived at Fort Carson and ceased while he was deployed overseas. After returning, authorities discovered DNA evidence tying him to several attempted abductions, including ones in Alabama in 2007 and Texas in 2009. Although his attorneys initially claimed the DNA might be Brian's, they ultimately retracted the argument. Lucas's sentencing means he will serve at least two decades behind bars before becoming eligible for parole. Several parents described how their children lost trust in anyone wearing a uniform, since Lucas often approached them in his Army attire. Despite a record of ten military medals, the judge decided the severity of his actions warranted a long prison term.

U početku je Lukas tvrdio da je njegov brat blizanac, Brajan, izvršio te napade, ali je kasnije odustao od te odbrane i priznao krivicu. Brajan Lukas se takođe suočava sa optužbama za sodomiju i zlostavljanje deteta prvog stepena u Alabami, iako negira bilo kakvu umešanost u Aronove zločine. U okviru sporazuma o priznanju krivice, neke optužbe u Koloradu su odbačene, a vlasti su odlučile da ne pokreću određene slučajeve u Teksasu i Alabami. Uprkos deset vojnih medalja, sudija je zaključio da težina njegovih dela zahteva dugu zatvorsku kaznu.

article_content: On Monday, the iconic TV sitcom 'Friends' marks its 20th anniversary, sparking a new survey that highlights British people's 'friendcestual' habits across the country. Almost a third (32%) of respondents have followed Ross and Rachel's footsteps by dating within their friend circle, while one in ten (10%) admit they have kissed more than two pals. Two in five (40%) of those aged 25 to 34 have dated a friend, and almost one quarter (24%) say they have had a sexual encounter with a friend. Nearly one in five (19%) have ended up kissing a friend on or after a boozy night out, much like Monica and Chandler's story. However, friend-based romances can come with complications. Around 17% of 18-24 year olds and 10% of 25-34 year olds revealed that such relationships ended badly, while 13% of 18-34 year olds regret getting involved in the first place. One in ten (13%) said they prefer meeting someone outside their social circle, but 19% admit they find it hard to expand beyond their immediate group. One in ten (10%) of 18-24 year olds have also experienced a love triangle with friends, and 8% of 25-34 year olds have dated a friend's sibling. Men appear more willing to pursue a friend, with 38% developing romantic feelings, compared to 29% of women. To commemorate 'Friends' turning 20, match.com released its findings on how common it is to date friends in real life, reflecting some of the show's most famous plotlines. Kate Taylor, relationship expert for match.com, warns that 'friendcest' can occur when limited social opportunities lead people to date within tight circles. Though it might seem easy, she points out the dangers if partners share friends but lack deeper compatibility. There's also a risk of staying together longer than intended, due to fear of damaging friendships. While romance can flourish for some couples, as with Ross and Rachel, other times it fizzles out much like the ill-fated pairing of Rachel and Joey.

Gotovo jedna petina (19%) kaže da je poljubila prijatelja tokom ili nakon noćnog provoda uz alkohol, slično odnosu Monike i Čendlera. Međutim, romantične veze među prijateljima mogu imati svoje mane. Čini se da su muškarci spremniji da pređu granicu između prijateljstva i romanse, jer je 38% razvilo romantična osećanja prema prijatelju, u poređenju sa 29% žena. Kako 'Prijatelji' slave 20. godišnjicu, match.com je objavio rezultate koji pokazuju koliko je u stvarnosti uobičajeno zabavljati se sa prijateljem, što podseća na neke od najpoznatijih zapleta iz serije. Iako to možda deluje praktično, ona ukazuje na rizik ukoliko partneri dele prijatelje ali nemaju dublju kompatibilnost. Takođe postoji opasnost da se ostane u vezi duže nego što bi trebalo, iz straha da se ne naruše društvene veze. Dok romansa može procvetati, kao kod Rosa i Rejčel, ponekad se može ugasiti, nalik ne tako uspešnoj vezi Rejčel i Džoi.

'CNN -- World champion Marc Marquez continued his impeccable start to the 2014 season with his third win in three races at the Argentina MotoGP on Sunday. The Honda rider also became the first since the great Italian Giacomo Agostini in 1971 to secure the first three races from pole position.',
          'The 21-year-old Spaniard, Marc Marquez, teamed up with Dani Pedrosa, who finished second ahead of Yamaha riders Jorge Lorenzo and Valentino Rossi in third and fourth respectively. Marquez, dominant in Qatar and Texas, did not have it all his own way in Argentina.',
          'Opting for a hard front tire, Marquez suffered a sluggish start and was as low as seventh on the second lap. But as his tires warmed up on the Autodromo Termas de Rio Hondo, hosting MotoGP for the first time, he powered through the field.',
          'By lap four, he was in second place and tracked Jorge Lorenzo for about a dozen laps before overtaking him. Marquez then pulled well clear, and Pedrosa also passed Lorenzo on the penultimate lap to complete a Repsol Honda one-two.',
          'Marquez now leads the standings with a perfect 75 points after three rounds, with Pedrosa on 56 and Rossi in third place on 41 points. He said: "The beginning was difficult. My tires were not good and I spun on the dirty side of the track. But it was fun. Jorge opened the gap, and I just kept pushing to catch him at the end."',
          'Stefan Bradl and Andrea Iannone finished fifth and sixth, while British rookie Bradley Smith came seventh in the top-class competition.',
          'In Moto2, Spanish championship leader Esteve Rabat claimed his second win of the season, while Italy’s Romano Fenati won the Moto3 race, denying Australian Jack Miller his third straight victory. MotoGP’s return to Argentina was its first since 1999, marking the third of 18 rounds for the season.'

'Former President Donald Trump’s lawyer argued that a gag order in his federal criminal case violates free speech. The gag order forbids Trump from publicly maligning prosecutors, potential witnesses, or court employees involved in the case. Trump stands accused of illegally trying to overturn his 2020 election defeat.',
          'Attorney John Sauer insisted that the order infringes on Trump’s First Amendment rights. Meanwhile, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia questioned whether Trump’s charged rhetoric could threaten the integrity of his upcoming trial. Judge Cornelia Pillard, one of three judges hearing the appeal, asked Sauer about how a fair trial interests factor into his arguments.',
          'U.S. District Court Judge Tanya Chutkan, overseeing the case, ruled that Trump or his lawyers publicly criticizing prosecutors, court staff, or potential witnesses could influence testimony or provoke threats. Still, Chutkan allowed Trump to criticize the Justice Department, President Joe Biden, and herself, and to claim that the prosecution is partisan retaliation.',
          'Sauer called the order unprecedented and warned it could have a chilling effect on core political speech. Trump, leading among Republicans for the 2024 presidential race, has repeatedly targeted officials involved in his numerous criminal and civil proceedings. He has referred to Special Counsel Jack Smith, who brought the federal election-related charges, as a ‘deranged lunatic’ and ‘thug.’',
          'The gag order, suspended during Trump’s appeal, underscores the clash between his right to free speech and the need for an impartial trial next year. Trump has pleaded not guilty in this and three other criminal cases. The judges asked Department of Justice lawyer Cecil VanDevender if the order was too broad. Judge Patricia Millett emphasized that the court must use a careful approach.',
          'VanDevender maintained that Trump can still claim the prosecution is politically motivated, call the Department of Justice corrupt, and assert he will be vindicated at trial. The appeals court did not indicate when it will make its ruling.'

          'Naredba o ćutanju, koja je suspendovana dok traje Trampova žalba, naglašava sukob između njegovog prava na slobodu govora i potrebe za nepristrasnim suđenjem naredne godine.           'VanDevender je istakao da Tramp i dalje može da tvrdi da je krivični postupak politički motivisan, da naziva Ministarstvo pravde korumpiranim i da veruje da će biti oslobođen na suđenju. Apelacioni sud nije precizirao kada će doneti odluku.'
